title: Dirichlet problems and exit distributions for the telegraph process and its planar extensions
summary: In this paper, we study boundary-value problems describing the exit distribution of finite-velocity random motions from prescribed domains. For the standard telegraph process, with and without drift, we derive the Dirichlet problems governing the exit point and mean exit time from a closed interval. We then extend the analysis to a planar finite-velocity model with orthogonal directions, for which we obtain the associated Laplace and Poisson-type equations for the exit distribution and mean exit time.
